claim: Direct TGV/OUIGO trains run Paris to La Rochelle (399 km) ~17 times a day, fastest in about 2h41m with no changes.
quote: the fastest services... it can take as little as 2 hours 41 minutes... around 17 trains per day running on this route, which spans 399 km. There's no need for any changes along the way, as there are direct trains available to La Rochelle.

claim: La Rochelle in June averages highs of 20.7C and lows of 14.8C, with ~9.6 hours of sun, 12.9 rain days and the longest daylight of the year at ~15h42m.
quote: average high temperatures of 20.7°C (69.3°F)... mean low temperature is 14.8°C (58.6°F)... rain falls for 12.9 days... average sunshine in June... is 9.6 hours, and June has the longest days of the year, with an average of 15 hours and 42 minutes of daylight.

claim: Sea temperature in early June is around 16.7C, rising to 18.4C by month's end (June average 18.1C).
quote: water temperatures start at around 16.7°C (62.1°F) in the first third of the month, rise to 17.5°C (63.5°F) mid-month, and reach 18.4°C (65.1°F) toward the end.

claim: The Passeur is a 3-minute on-demand electro-solar ferry across the Vieux-Port (Tour de la Chaine to Mediatheque) at 1.50 EUR; the Bus de Mer links Vieux-Port to Port des Minimes in 20 minutes at 3 EUR, running every 60 min off-season and every 30 min in July-August.
quote: Passeur... Connects the Vieux-Port (Tour de la Chaîne) with the Médiathèque... '3 minutes'... Single ticket costs €1.50... Bus de Mer... Links the Vieux-Port to Port des Minimes... '20 minutes'... Single ticket is €3... every 60 minutes off-season, every 30 minutes in July-August.

claim: La Rochelle-Ile de Re airport (LRH) is 5 km north of the city, served by Ryanair and easyJet to ~12 destinations including London Stansted/Gatwick, Bristol, Manchester, Dublin, Lyon, Marseille, Porto, Geneva and Marrakech.
quote: situated 5km from La Rochelle... Ryanair and easyJet being the only airlines operating... Dublin, Marseille and London Stansted are the 3 most popular routes... Bristol and London Gatwick via easyJet... Manchester via easyJet... Lyon via easyJet... Porto in Portugal and Geneva in Switzerland... Marrakech in Morocco via Ryanair

claim: Yélo's yellow self-service bikes (Freebike) number ~800 across ~115 stations, available 24/7; first 30 min cost 1 EUR for occasional users (free for subscribers), then 1.50 EUR per extra half-hour.
quote: 800 vélos are available at 115 stations... accessible 7 days a week, 24 hours a day... For occasional users without a subscription, the first 30 minutes cost 1€, and after that you are billed 1.50€ for each additional half-hour.

claim: On-street parking is 4 EUR for 2 hours (green zone, the max duration) or 9.50 EUR for 7.5 hours (orange hyper-center zone); free Sundays and holidays, with a 1 EUR/night Fri-Sun rate at Verdun and Vieux-Port Sud.
quote: green zone... €4 for two hours (the maximum authorized parking duration)... orange zone (hyper-center)... €9.50 for seven and a half hours... special rate of €1 per night (between 7pm and 6am) on all Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays... metered zones become free on Sundays and public holidays.

claim: Main visitor car parks include Vieux-Port Ouest (Saint-Jean-d'Acre, closest to the towers), Encan (by the aquarium), Verdun (city centre) and Saint-Nicolas; enclosed/underground parks give the first hour free Oct 1-Jun 30.
quote: Parking Vieux Port Ouest... closest to the towers and old port... Parking Encan... opposite the La Rochelle Aquarium... Parking Verdun... largest car parks in the city center... From October 1st to June 30th, the first hour of parking is free in enclosed and underground car parks.

claim: Best stay areas are the Vieux-Port (historic heart, close to towers/aquarium but busy), the Gabut (colourful former fishermen's quarter, quieter), lively Saint-Nicolas near the station, and upscale seaside La Genette; the city is compact, ~10 min on foot from station to Vieux-Port.
quote: Vieux-Port... historic and touristic heart... ideal area to stay... a very busy area in high season... Gabut... brightly painted wooden houses... relative tranquility even during peak tourist season... Saint-Nicolas is the liveliest neighborhood... after sunset... La Genette is the most sought-after neighborhood... 10 minutes on foot from the train station area to the Vieux-Port.
